cases.prompt: Audit access and refresh tokens persisted in AsyncStorage and copied into verbose production logs.
expect: Finds plaintext persistence and log disclosure
Distinguishes encrypted storage from hardware-backed key protection
Covers migration, logout cleanup, backups, and verification

cases.prompt: Review an offline SQLite cache containing customer PII with unrestricted backups and no retention policy.
expect: Identifies data-at-rest, backup, and retention exposure
Calibrates protection to the data classification
Recommends minimization and React Native-compatible storage controls
